scope: Super Power Drill printed p128-135 only; other product cutting data and application factors are excluded.

value_policy.missing: null preserves source dash/blank and must never become 0
value_policy.source_ranges: The Super Power Drill cutting table prints two endpoints, not a manufacturer optimum.
value_policy.site_midpoint: The arithmetic midpoint is a labeled adjustable site starting value, not a printed manufacturer optimum.
value_policy.feed_unit: mm/rev, not mm/tooth; never multiply by center/periphery insert count
value_policy.material_boundary: Source uses C<0.3% and C>0.3%; exactly C=0.3% is not assigned by the catalog.
value_policy.feed_raw_format: Two-decimal feed endpoints preserve the printed table convention; sequence preserves the printed endpoint order.
value_policy.no_borrowing: Never fill a missing product/material/grade/depth/diameter cell from another product, material, grade or condition.

section.depth_basis_status: Website rule: select the class automatically from the chosen body's catalog drilling depth T divided by nominal diameter D. T/D<7 selects T<7D; T/D>7 selects T>7D. Required hole depth and legacy spdDepthClass values do not select the row. Exactly T/D=7 has no catalog row and remains unresolved.
section.exactly_7d_status: not defined; do not silently change either inequality to <= or >=

no_catalog_cutting_data.status: not listed in p135 cutting table

grade_pairing_notes.text: Center CD6 and CD8 each list NC2032 and NC40 on p132; source separates base part and grade rather than printing every full grade-suffixed order code.
NC40 periphery is physically listed only as N9GX06020431 and N9GX09030831; p135 has no NC40+NC40 feed values for diameters19-21.
Dimensions match corresponding NC2032 periphery inserts, but direct holder interchangeability must be confirmed before asserting a complete validated assembly.

grade_pairing_notes.value: CD6 and CD8 each list NC2032 and NC40 physical grade variants, so both center grades in p135 are physically listed. The catalog separates base part and grade; do not invent a complete ordering suffix.

Periphery N9GX060204 screw is NS-22062 in p132 insert table, while p131 holder rows Dia.30-34 specify NS-22055. Keep both source values; obtain the manufacturer-approved mapping rather than silently overriding either.

operating_notes.value: Recommend a spot hole before drilling; see p133
Cutting speed relates to periphery inserts; feed depends on center pilot insert load.
Feed may be adjusted ±25% of recommended value based on chip shape; short chips are preferred.
When spindle load is15% higher than starting power consumption, index periphery to next edge and replace center pilot insert.
Increase cutting speed and feed20% for horizontal-spindle machine.
No cumulative/stacking rule for chip ±25%, horizontal +20%, application factors or range endpoints is printed.

metric_rpm.basis: Common metric mathematics; not attributed to a formula page in this product PDF.

metric_feed.basis: Unit conversion; do not multiply by insert quantity.

calculation.z_reason: Requested hole depth is not the actual tool-tip Z. Tip offset, bottom profile and breakthrough allowance are not sufficiently defined.

power_reference.scope_note: A material Kc entry is a load-calculation reference, not evidence that this drill or grade is suitable for that material. H55HRC Kc must not expand H<50 cutting scope.

printed_feed_force.status: ap is not defined in this page legend; confirmation required before executable output

printed_torque.status: Preserve printed formula; confirm applicable variable/unit convention and factory calculation example before relying on torque/power results.

power_reference.implementation_plan: Catalog title mentions power but no explicit kW/efficiency formula is printed on p134. First version may show source Kc and formulas as references; machine-load guarantee or auto-pass based on motor kW requires confirmed formula/efficiency.

spd_marketing_depth.scope: Marketing claim; actual selectable capacity remains the individual holder table T, not a blanket 12D for every standard SKU.

spd_custom_request.scope: Custom on request only; not a standard available SKU or a promise that the two maxima are simultaneously achievable.

spd_table_diameter.scope: Holder table heading; do not promote this to a guaranteed finished-hole tolerance or to a controlled radial-adjustment range.

finished_hole_quality.scope: General better finish/straightness/roundness claims and the p133 single roughness case are not per-SKU guarantees.

manufacturer_questions.question: 網站依所選刀體的型錄鑽深 T ÷ 標稱孔徑 D 自動選列；p135 只列 T<7D 與 T>7D，未列 T/D=7。請確認刀體恰好 7D 時應採的資料列或正式切削條件。
請補中心尖與外刃軸向差、完整圓柱段深度、盲孔底形及貫穿餘量。

Ø30–34 刀體表 NS-22055 與刀片表 NS-22062 應如何選用？

請定義 p134 ap、Md 常數與單位、功率效率及計算案例；Kc 資料不代替切削表。
